sft_rationale: Secreted Zn venom endopeptidase cleaving fibrinogen alpha/beta chains is correct; bradykinin release from kininogen is unsupported; plasminogen-independent direct fibrinolysis not stated.
LRR receptor kinase, brassinosteroid binding, co-receptor dimerization and endosomal signaling are correct; cell-death and UV-B claims unsupported; BZR1/BES1 output omitted.

Nuclear RING E3 degrading photomorphogenic TFs in darkness with WD40 substrate recruitment is correct; DNA-repair claim unsupported; light-induced nuclear exclusion described as intranuclear redistribution.

ER-membrane ethylene receptor, histidine kinase, negative regulator, homodimer, Raf-like kinase partner correct; 'extracellular' ethylene-binding module is wrong for an ER TM sensor; copper cofactor omitted.
Secreted endo-acting alpha-1,4 glucan hydrolase with catalytic, beta and starch-binding modules is correct; calcium dependence omitted.
Secreted subtilisin zymogen, broad extracellular proteolysis, nutrient acquisition correct; dampening clot formation unsupported; Phr pheromone processing/quorum sensing and calcium omitted.

Central claim of a ring-forming ATPase powering DNA uptake is wrong; ComK is a K-box transcription activator (mentioned only secondarily); 'endospore core' location wrong; autoregulation and MecA-ClpCP control absent.

Polar coiled-coil scaffold is right, but it is presented as recruiting Z-ring components to initiate polar septation (it recruits MinJ/MinCD to prevent it) and as a flagellar basal-body nucleator; curvature sensing, sporulation and chromosome anchoring absent.

C-ring switch component that promotes CheY-P dephosphorylation is correct, but the phosphatase activity is attributed to an associated protein rather than FliY itself, and hook/filament assembly coordination is unsupported.
Tubulin-like GTPase forming the Z ring, recruiting partners and driving septation is accurate; treadmilling and spatial regulators only implicit.
ATP-driven Sec translocase motor at the membrane is accurate; linkage to an anti-sigma substrate and sporulation is unsupported.

Sigma-70 family sporulation sigma factor under anti-sigma/anti-anti-sigma control is correct; claimed targets (cell wall remodelling, extracellular proteases, spore coat) are wrong; forespore specificity absent.

Late sporulation sigma factor is correct, but proteolytic maturation, spore-lysis/dissemination targets and a phosphorylation-protease control axis are wrong; forespore specificity and Gin anti-sigma control absent.
Described as a primary (housekeeping-like) sigma factor; late mother-cell sporulation identity, pro-sigma-K processing and skin-element excision absent.
Phosphorelay-activated response regulator that dimerizes, binds DNA and initiates sporulation, asymmetric division and biofilm is accurate; repressor role (abrB) and graded fate control omitted.

Export from mother cell into the forespore core and promotion of flagellar assembly/swarming are wrong; PP2C module mentioned but SpoIIAA-P phosphatase activity, sigma-F activation and polar septum role absent.
Membrane aspartic protease activating a sigma precursor for mother-cell transcription is correct; precursor called forespore-derived; SpoIIR-mediated activation omitted.
Membrane-recruited AGC kinase integrating insulin/PI3K signals to growth and survival matches the (minimal, INITIALIZED) reference; immune tone and tissue-repair claims are unsupported by it.
Blue-light flavoprotein resetting the clock is correct, but it is said to stabilise clock repressors, the opposite of light-triggered TIM degradation via JET.
ATP-dependent HSP90 chaperone with co-chaperones, kinase clients, centrosome, RNA silencing and sleep roles is accurate; some location claims unsupported; exosome membrane-deforming role absent.
Peptidoglycan-hydrolysing lysozyme activity is correct, but it is framed as a hemolymph immune effector; the reference establishes a digestive gut enzyme repressed by infection.
NAD+ synthesis from NMN plus holdase chaperone function and neuronal maintenance are correct; synaptic deacylase fuelling and metabolic-chromatin hub are unsupported; isoform biology absent.
ARF GAP scaffold with Pix/PAK, synaptic vesicle recycling, muscle morphogenesis and Hippo-mediated growth restraint matches the reference closely.

Cytosolic holdase cooperating with chaperone systems is correct, but it is described as reducing client disulfides; the reference states the Trx-like domain is not a functional oxidoreductase. HOCl activation absent.

Periplasmic Cpx auxiliary protein that modulates the sensor and hands misfolded clients to proteases is correct; refolding-promoting holdase activity is overstated relative to the reference's DegP-coupled adaptor role.
J-domain co-chaperone, zinc module, thiol-disulfide activity, sigma-32 regulation and replication support are all covered; membrane-proximal assemblies are unsupported.
ATP-driven Hsp70 cycle with J-proteins and NEF, disaggregation and sigma-32 antagonism are accurate; replication roles and trigger-factor cooperation omitted.
Double-ring chaperonin with GroES cap, encapsulation and ATP cycle, and phage capsid assembly support are accurate and complete.

2-iminopropanoate deaminase trimer is correct, but the damage chemistry (heme nitrosation, nitrosative stress) and product (acetate) are wrong; PLP-enzyme/IlvA context and HOCl-activated holdase only partly captured.
ATP-independent export holdase delivering unfolded preproteins to the translocon is accurate; called dimeric (it is a tetramer); SecA handoff not named.
Periplasmic holdase for unfolded OMPs delivering to the assembly machinery is accurate; 'likely dimeric' is wrong for the trimeric jellyfish; LPS role absent.
FKBP PPIase with holdase insertion and nickel delivery for hydrogenase maturation is accurate; the stress-state switching claim is unsupported.
Periplasmic stress-induced holdase is accurate; coordination with efflux systems is speculative; refolding-while-bound mechanism and Bae/Cpx induction only partly captured.
Septal class B PBP transpeptidase forming 4-3 cross-links, beta-lactam target, is accurate; FtsW partnership omitted.
Class B PBP2 transpeptidase in the elongasome for lateral wall growth and rod shape, beta-lactam sensitive, is accurate and complete.
Periplasmic OMP chaperone delivering to BAM is accurate; the PPIase activity is presented as driving folding although it is dispensable in vivo.
Periplasmic PQQ alcohol dehydrogenase is correct, but it is described as calcium-stabilised (PedH is the lanthanide-dependent paralog of PedE), with unsupported lactate oxidation and NAD as acceptor.
Heterochromatin boundary role is recognisable, but the central claim of an active Fe/2OG H3K9 demethylase is wrong for this degenerate JmjC protein; Swi6 binding and SAGA/Bdf2 recruitment absent.
SDR NADP-dependent oxidoreductase is right, but the substrates (arabitol, xylose, galactose) and mitochondrial location are wrong; sorbose reductase function absent.
ARM-repeat adaptor at the spindle pole body matches the minimal reference; microtubule nucleation, motor assembly and cytokinesis roles are unsupported extensions.
Described as an ER flippase-delivery adaptor; it is a GPI-anchored cell-surface heme receptor for iron acquisition.
IMS small-Tim hexamer chaperoning carrier precursors to the TIM22 insertion machinery, oxidatively folded, is accurate and complete.

FAD aldonolactone oxidase producing an ascorbate-type antioxidant and H2O2 is recognisable, but the substrate (L-gulonolactone rather than D-arabinono-1,4-lactone) and matrix location (rather than outer membrane) are wrong.

Initiation-complex adaptor at the PAS is correct, but promotion of Atg1 kinase activation is contradicted for S. pombe and nuclear transit is unsupported; Atg13 HORMA heterodimer stabilisation absent.
Scaffold of the Atg1 initiation complex coupling nutrient signalling to kinase activation, with mitophagy, is accurate; Atg101/Atg17 partners and Atg9 vesicle recruitment not named.

Described as an Atg8/Atg12-like ubiquitin-like modifier that is itself matured and conjugated; Atg16 is the coiled-coil scaffold of the Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 E3-like complex. SPB and chromosome-segregation roles unsupported.
ER-phagophore bridge-like lipid transporter for autophagosome biogenesis is accurate; nuclear-envelope expansion is speculative; Atg18/Atg9 cooperation not named.
Subunit organising autophagy-specific PI3K complex I at the PAS is accurate; relocalisation to the vacuole is unsupported; the S. pombe-specific AIM feedback is absent.
Atg12-conjugated component of the E3-like complex driving Atg8 lipidation at the PAS, with mitophagy and reticulophagy, is accurate; a meiotic role is speculative and not supported.
ER GPI inositol-deacylase licensing ER-to-Golgi transport of GPI proteins is accurate; cytokinesis and ERAD roles omitted.
Vacuolar metallo-exopeptidase recycling amino acids is recognisable, but it is called an aminopeptidase (reference: M20A carboxypeptidase) with an unsupported peroxisomal pool.
Secreted GH18 chitinase-like protein is right, but it is presented as an active septal chitinase driving cell separation, although it lacks the catalytic Glu and vegetative walls lack chitin.
Non-catalytic, substrate-positioning membrane subunit of the ER GPI transamidase is accurate and complete.
Prx5-like fold and stress-protein engagement are recognisable, but the central claim of an active thioredoxin-supplied peroxidase is contradicted by direct assays; holdase function only secondary.

Nucleolar rDNA-binding MYBBP1A-family factor coupling rRNA production to early pre-rRNA processing is essentially correct; anchoring the transcription machinery and RNA-silencing contacts are unsupported; LSU biogenesis omitted.

Protein-interaction adaptor promoting pheromone signalling and mating via Ras is recognisable; BTB/POZ interface, ER/SPB positioning and MAPK-module scaffolding are unsupported; cell-shape role omitted.

PX-BAR sorting nexin binding PI3P on endosomal/autophagic membranes to drive selective autophagy is accurate; retromer scaffolding and mitochondria/ER specificity are overstated; Snx4 partnership omitted.
Confident splicing-factor identity and nucleolar residence are invented for an uncharacterised SMAP-domain protein with no established function.
Typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxin reduced by the thioredoxin system, with peroxide signalling to transcription, is accurate; Pap1/Sty1 relays and hyperoxidation/Srx1 gating not named.
Glutamine-dependent CTP synthase supplying CTP, forming cytoplasmic filaments that modulate activity, is accurate and complete.

BH3-groove regulator restraining MOMP and caspase activation at mitochondrial, ER and nuclear membranes, limiting autophagy and ion flux, is accurate; described as multi-pass though it is tail-anchored.
Heme electron carrier between complexes III and IV and apoptosome trigger after MOMP is accurate and complete.

Mitochondrial iron chaperone supporting ISC assembly, heme synthesis and ferroxidase protection is accurate; autoprocessing is wrong (MPP processing) and the cytochrome c/proliferation link is unsupported; allosteric NFS1 activation not stated.

Glycolytic GAPDH with RNA-binding translational repression, immune signalling and protease modulation moonlighting is accurate; glycolytic channeling is unsupported; S-nitrosylation/Siah1 nuclear apoptosis axis omitted.
BTB-Kelch CUL3 adaptor targeting NRF2 for degradation, released by electrophile modification, with p62-linked autophagic routing, is accurate and complete.

bHLH-LZ E-box transcription factor activating and repressing Pol II programmes for growth and proliferation is accurate; MAX partner unnamed; cytoskeletal/ER relocalisation claims unsupported; FBXW7 turnover omitted.
CNC-bZIP factor with small Maf binding AREs under KEAP1 restraint is accurate; promotion of ubiquitin-independent ERAD is unsupported; ferroptosis protection omitted.
Dual-specificity lipid/protein phosphatase removing PIP3 3-phosphate, antagonising PI3K-AKT, with C2/PDZ membrane targeting and nuclear pool, is accurate and complete.

RRM protein binding UG-rich RNA, regulating splicing, stability and translation, with LCD-driven phase separation and aggregation, is accurate; host-symbiont and nuclear-envelope claims unsupported; cryptic-exon repression and autoregulation absent.
Secreted disulfide homodimeric growth factor binding endothelial receptors with heparin/ECM tethering is accurate; anti-angiogenic VEGF165b isoform biology absent.
Phosphoinositide-recruited AGC kinase activated by PDK1/TORC2 controlling metabolism, survival, growth and motility matches the reference.

BH3-groove anti-apoptotic regulator at mitochondria, ER and nuclear envelope with calcium, autophagy and lymphocyte roles is accurate; phosphatase-recruited protein stabilisation and viral latency are unsupported.
EF-hand calcium sensor regulating enzymes, channels and trafficking factors is accurate; named kinase/phosphatase targets and muscle/cardiac roles only generic.
Single-pass RTK binding EGF ligands, dimerising with ERBBs, autophosphorylating and signalling via RAS-MAPK, PI3K-AKT, PLCgamma and STAT with endocytic trafficking is accurate and complete.
Lipid-anchored raft-enriched Src-family kinase in immune, cytoskeletal and synaptic signalling is accurate; reelin signalling not named.
E-box bHLH-LZ heterodimeric transcription factor regulating growth, proliferation, ribosome biogenesis and apoptosis is accurate; spindle and axon localisation claims unsupported.
Dual-specificity lipid/protein phosphatase antagonising PI3K-AKT with membrane, cytoplasmic and nuclear pools is accurate and complete.
Tetrameric stress-activated transcription factor controlling arrest, repair, apoptosis and metabolism with mitochondrial priming is accurate and complete.
Phosphoinositide-recruited AGC kinase driving insulin/RTK signalling, glucose metabolism, survival and growth is accurate and covers the reference's core biology.
Executioner caspase zymogen activated by initiator caspases, cleaving after Asp to dismantle cytoskeletal and nuclear structures, is accurate; ICAD/DNA fragmentation and PARP only implicit.
ER Hsp70 folding/triage chaperone tuning the UPR is correct, but it is said to associate with the cytoplasmic face of the ER membrane (it is luminal) and a BAG3 anti-apoptotic complex is unsupported.
Dual-phosphorylation-activated ERK2 terminal kinase of the MAPK cascade phosphorylating cytoplasmic and nuclear substrates, opposed by DUSPs, is accurate and complete.

AMPK alpha catalytic subunit sensing energy in a heterotrimer and switching catabolism on/anabolism off is accurate; TSC2/RPTOR wording and HSF4 are imprecise or unsupported; H2B phosphorylation omitted.
Calcium-binding SMP30 lactonase with calcium homeostasis and antiproliferative roles is accurate; lipid-biosynthesis and developmental extensions are unsupported; vitamin C biosynthesis not stated.
Apical Na+-coupled glucose/galactose symporter in intestine and kidney is accurate; one-sodium stoichiometry is wrong (2:1); water permeation omitted.

Hsp70 co-chaperone binding the ATPase domain is recognisable, but it is said to stimulate Hsp70 ATP hydrolysis and dock Hsp90; the reference establishes stabilisation of the ADP state and slowed cycling.

Tetrameric stress-responsive transcription factor switching between arrest and apoptosis with MDM2-type ubiquitin control is accurate; transporter-linked cation/pH homeostasis unsupported; DNA repair and senescence not named.
ER-luminal folding sensor reglucosylating N-glycans of non-native glycoproteins to re-engage calnexin/calreticulin is accurate and complete.

Dual-localised bZIP factor engaging mitochondrial proteostasis is recognisable, but its UPRmt master-regulator role and import-efficiency sensing are absent; mitochondrial small-RNA and lipid-droplet claims are unsupported.
EF-hand calcium sensor regulating kinases, phosphatases and channels with spindle, meiotic and chemotaxis contexts is accurate; calcineurin partnership not named.
Dynamin-related GTPase assembling on the outer membrane to drive mitochondrial fission, with apoptotic remodelling, is accurate; CED-3 cleavage omitted.

bHLH E-box factor activating autophagy and lipid genes for longevity is accurate; TFEB orthology, lysosome biogenesis, nutrient-regulated nuclear translocation and immunity are absent; sphingolipid/plasma-membrane claim unsupported.
HSE-binding stress transcription factor coordinating heat, proteostasis, immunity, development and lifespan is accurate; calmodulin modulation unsupported.
ATP-driven HSP90 chaperone with co-chaperones stabilising kinases and receptors, supporting chemotaxis, dauer and lifespan is accurate; nuclear export and raft localisation unsupported.
ER single-pass sensor with kinase-activated RNase acting on mRNAs and an XBP-1-type bZIP effector is accurate; unconventional xbp-1 splicing not explicitly named.
PE-conjugated Atg8 scaffold binding LIR receptors for autophagosome assembly, aggrephagy and mitophagy is accurate; ATG-4 processing and LGG-2 recruitment omitted.
Organisation of RNA-repression factors in germ cells is recognisable, but it is called an ER-anchored single-pass membrane adaptor; P-granule scaffold identity and self-association are absent.

Damage-sensing mitochondrial kinase that accumulates on the outer membrane and activates a ubiquitin ligase for mitophagy is accurate; fission-GTPase phosphorylation unsupported; ubiquitin Ser65 phosphorylation absent.
Dual-phosphorylation-activated p38-type MAPK controlling immune and stress transcription, opposed by DUSPs, is accurate; SEK-1 upstream and SKN-1/ATF-7 substrates not named.

CNC-type factor activating detoxification and proteostasis genes under stress, with ubiquitin-ligase turnover, development and lifespan roles, is accurate; leucine-zipper dimerisation is wrong (SKN-1 binds DNA as a monomer); isoform biology absent.
Carnitine O-acetyltransferase shuttling acetyl units between peroxisomes and mitochondria is accurate; dual-isoform origin by alternative initiation omitted.
Kinase-specific Hsp90 co-chaperone stabilising and delivering immature kinases, with downstream MAPK, cell-cycle and SPB contexts, is accurate and complete.

Hexameric ATP-driven disaggregase cooperating with Hsp70/Hsp40 for thermotolerance and stress-granule disassembly is accurate; secretory-client folding and trehalose links unsupported; prion propagation absent.
Mitochondrial double-ring chaperonin with Hsp10 folding imported proteins, with nucleoid/mtDNA roles, is accurate and complete.
Type I ER sensor with kinase-activated RNase splicing a cytoplasmic mRNA (HAC1) to drive the UPR programme is accurate and complete.
ER-luminal Hsp70 driving translocation, folding, ERAD, UPR regulation and karyogamy with J-proteins and NEFs is accurate and complete.
ER-luminal oxidoreductase catalysing disulfide formation, isomerisation and reduction, with ERAD triage, is accurate and complete.
Lipid-anchored GTPase activating adenylate cyclase/cAMP-PKA, regulated by GEF and GAPs, with pseudohyphal growth, is accurate; Cdc42/MAPK polarity role omitted.
NAD-dependent histone deacetylase silencing telomeres, HM loci and rDNA with recombination suppression is accurate; lifespan framed as chronological rather than replicative.
Cytosolic Hsp70 ATP cycle with J-proteins and NEFs, folding, degradation triage, targeting and disaggregation cooperation is accurate and complete.
